sentences.text: Megalodytes was an extinct genus of waterfowl.
It belongs to the subfamily Cygninae within the family Anatidae.
The only known species is M. morejohni, recognized from fragmentary wingbones.
Fossils once thought to be Megalodytes from Japan are now placed in the genus Annakacygna.
Currently, the Paleobiology Database records two occurrences of this animal.
This waterfowl lived between 15.98 and 7.246 million years ago during the Langhian to Tortonian stages.
